text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho comes to a close with us failing to get any closer to her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Manhattan Cafe takes an interest in Special Week's ability to run at full tilt after consuming large portions of food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for our next challenge, it only makes sense that we should aim for the spring Grand Prix—the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, enticed by her friend's invitation, Manhattan Cafe tells me that she wants to participate in a big race overseas. Considering the condition of her toenails though, that'd be far too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But we did promise to chase her friend… Keeping the Takarazuka Kinen as an option, I decide to wait and make the final decision about France next month.
